items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And Frank Sinatra, I played trumpet with Frank for about four or five years.

ctx.x: No, what kind of things stick out in your mind with some of these stars? Are they great to work with the majority of them?

Yeah, yeah they are. Usually the more they’ve done, the less frightened they are, and the nicer they are you see? And Frank Sinatra, I played trumpet with Frank for about four or five years. And Frank’s pilots flew me into Vegas many times, at least six or seven times I can think of, because of the one show at ten o’clock, and I finished “The Carol Burnett Show” like about eight thirty or quarter of nine or nine o’clock and I’d try to rush out, they’d have a car for me, and go to Burbank, and they’d take off and…
